text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Okay, pumpkins, bell peppers, and corn… 
Yup, we've got everything they've asked
for!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for keeping track of the shopping
list Chiyo-chan♪ 
I'm getting so excited for the barbeque at
the end of 
the summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm also excited! After all,
summer and barbeque always 
go together!
And when you think of barbeque you think 
of your class president!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's all work together to follow the rules
and make sure no one gets burnt!
Let's eat our fill and have heaps of
fun!! 
Hahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That being said,
we still haven't bought carrots. 
Are we really going to be okay without
some?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I heard that they were bringing them 
by the truckload directly to the campsite!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
But anyways, as Baku-chan said, we need 
to make sure to eat a bunch and have fun!
So…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
When we get back to campus I need to work
really hard. 
I still haven't made up for the time I missed
in Spring 
due to my injury!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Laurel-san… Please don't overdo it!
I can tell you've been 
pushing yourself really hard during this
Summer camp as well!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, don't worry about me♪ 
Chiyo-chan, you of all people should know that,
right? 
After all,
I'm good at dealing with injuries!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Woah! Look at that watermelon over there,
it's so big and 
looks absolutely delicious!
I bet everyone would be happy 
if we brought it back for them!
Give me a second you two!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Mhm! That's how Laurel-san always is!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She's… so strong.
She's always been like that, 
even before she came to the academy… 
Even when we trained together in the "Victory
Club."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"One must always be strong-willed!" 
"One must live full of positivity and
energy!" 
That's what all members of the Victory Club
are taught!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And of course our names are synonymous with
strong flowers!! 
As such, "No matter the difficulty,
one must always push through."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We must always have fortitude. 
And in that respect,
Laurel is second to none…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Baku-chan, Chiyo-chan,
sorry for making you wait!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe,
their watermelons looked so delicious that
I ended 
up buying a bunch! But don't worry,
I'll carry them all back!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, also,
if your bags get too heavy on our 
way back just let me know!
I'll carry them for you♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
Laurel-san! I'm still worried about you!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey… come here for a sec. 
Isn't that girl's plate lookin' a little
empty, 
why don't we give her some more carrots…?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
No way no way!! That girl… isn't she 
from that like super famous Grand
Family…!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey hey hey hey!! 
Milady, are you trying some of the foods!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I have just finished my meal. 
Therefore, I am leaving.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hold on, wait! M-Milady!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I said hold on, weit!
Why're you at the beach when we're havin' 
a rad BBQ!? You're gonna go for a swim!?
I'm guessin' you 
wanted to swim so bad that you couldn't hold
it in anymore?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I do not have any plans to swim… 
I simply wanted to do a bit of running after
my meal.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You're doin' some training!? Ehhh,
for realz!? 
What about the BBQ!?
What about the summer party!? 
You're not gonna come and get hyped!?!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I ate as much as was necessary already. 
You can feel free to return to your party
though.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's not the point!! Ungh, Milady,
such a buzzkill… 
You're legit super ultra salty everyday!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Umm… are you done?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
this isn't over yet! I'll never give up! 
Umm, well if you don't wanna join us for 
the BBQ,
what about the watermelon splitting!?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hahh, hahh, hahh, hahh, hahh… 
Hmmmmh―!!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Alright, that went well…

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san… great work.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ruby! Huh, what about the barbeque…? 
Did you manage to get out of it? 
Ahaha, I guess I shouldn't be one to talk.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Your form… it was quite brilliant.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Thanks! That helps me 
feel more confident in my abilities.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Is… that so?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Anyways, Ruby, are you going for a run?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That is correct.
Even if it's our last day of 
this camp, we cannot neglect our training.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Be brilliant. Be the best.
And always shine the brightest." 
That is my family's motto… 
And as such I must adhere to that duty.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Got it. Umm,
I know that it's a little different from 
what you're talking about,
but… I have to win too. 
I need to repay all of the people that saved
me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaah!! Miracle, Milady,
what're you two doin'!? 
We're s'posed to be havin' fun!!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Helios! Ahahaha,
you're always so energetic! 
But don't worry about me,
I'm having a blast right now!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe… The wind is breathing in new life. 
A noble, heavenly wind. An earnest,
dry wind. A cheerful gale.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
However,
I will be the breeze that sweeps them all
away. 
Ahh… I can already smell the end of
summer.
